criteria.requirement: The 3D auditorium has eight raked rows of twelve seats, stage and balcony supports that obstruct some views.
criteria.action: Inspect the auditorium, seat grid, stage and obstructed views.
criteria.expected: Eight raked rows of twelve seats and balcony supports form a plausible 3D auditorium with some obstructed sightlines.

criteria.requirement: Selecting an available seat shows its price and a plausible eye-level view from that actual location.
criteria.action: Select several available seats and compare their previews and prices.
criteria.expected: Each selection shows its price and moves to an eye-level view from that seat's actual location.

criteria.requirement: Two seat views can be compared and differences in position/obstruction remain visually meaningful.
criteria.action: Compare two seats with different positions or obstructions.
criteria.expected: The two previews preserve meaningful differences in sightline and location.

criteria.requirement: Adjacent seats can be selected with a correct running total; reserved seats stay unavailable.
criteria.action: Select adjacent seats, inspect the total and attempt to select reserved seats.
criteria.expected: Adjacent selections total correctly and reserved seats cannot be booked.

criteria.requirement: A local booking summary agrees with selection, with a usable phone seating plan and no payment-service requirement.
criteria.action: Open the local booking summary and repeat seating selection on a phone.
criteria.expected: Summary matches selected seats and prices; the phone plan is usable without a payment service.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the auditorium and available/reserved seat map.
Preview contrasting near/far or obstructed seats and compare two eye-level views.
Try a reserved seat, select an adjacent group, change quantity and inspect totals and the local summary.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
